node.statement: Price the non-halo positive rows: on B one has d_j<=a*tau, while rows with d_j=0 contribute zero. Since H={j:d_j>a*tau} and sigma(v)-sigma_a(v)=sum_{j:0<d_j<=a*tau} a_j^+, it follows that sum_{j in B} a_j^+ d_j <= a*tau*(sigma(v)-sigma_a(v)). Combining this with the lem-residual-upper inequality proves the residual-pricing claim.
